question:
What should come in place of ? in the given series?

56 54 50 48 44 ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

The series is alternating between subtracting 2 and 4 from the previous number:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6d2dace8719b1cdfcf59dd0a76ba586acc742cf5a12f156750e68ccf7f228d45.png]
